faq.q: What is a titanium embolization coil mandrel?
faq.a: A titanium embolization coil mandrel is a precision-machined interventional component used in embolization coil delivery mandrel (nitinol). Manufactured from Nitinol (ASTM F2063) for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium embolization coil mandrel?
faq.a: Titanium Embolization Coil Mandrel is designed for embolization coil delivery mandrel (nitinol). The Nitinol (ASTM F2063) grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium embolization coil mandrel manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Embolization Coil Mandrel is manufactured using Laser micro-cutting. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium embolization coil mandrel?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
